name: ACE-Step
title: ACE-Step: free Suno alternative
hook: Suno charges you ten bucks a month to make songs with AI. This app does it for free.
job: Makes full songs from a prompt

features.say: Add your own lyrics in over fifty languages, and get songs up to ten minutes long.
Make covers, repaint one part, or split out stems.
On a good graphics card, a whole song takes about ten seconds.

install_line: Just grab the free download for Windows and Mac.
caption:
Suno charges $10/month to make songs with AI. ACE-Step does it for free 🎵

✅ Full songs from a simple description, up to 10 minutes
✅ Your own lyrics in 50+ languages
✅ Covers, repaint and stem splitting
✅ Runs on your own computer, no subscription

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ Heads up: it runs on your own hardware, so you need a graphics card (an NVIDIA GPU, or an Apple Silicon Mac), and the first launch downloads the AI models.

Comment "SONG" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
